text:
maria: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
- did: landed RFC for routing-policy refactor (rl-refactor) and wired basic policy flags into /generate route
- blockers: synthetic load shows token-bucket mismatch vs prod sim, seeing ~10% extra 429s in one traffic shape
- today: open CR for the rate tweak, coordinate canary with infra, need a second approval on the policy change

jamal: can you drop the short PoC numbers here? curious about p95 and 429 distribution

maria: quick paste from the 5m run against staging-rt1:
```
# locust 5m window summary
requests: 360k
throughput: ~1200 rps
p95: 140ms
429: 0.9% (mostly at tail of ramp)
errors: ~0.02% conn resets
```

oliver: fwiw I reran on dedicated-staging with KV cache pre-warmed — 429 dropped to ~0.1%. TTL/cold-kv looks like a contributor

lee: auth-rotation job still rolling in staging; saw a small jitter in token refresh timings that created a flurry of auth retries for long-poll sockets earlier, might amplify 429s in some shapes @maria

maria: noted. CR is up: https://git.redwood/infra/apigw/pull/1234 — add a short e2e and the TTL tweak is in the description. cc @jamal @lee

jamal: quick skim — one nit about naming in the policy table, and can we assert X-Rate-Limit-Policy header in e2e? makes debugging simpler

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service apigw-routeplane v2 -> canary-12 (10% traffic) :rocket:

maria: thanks — will watch canary metrics for 15m. If canary 429 > 2% or p95 > 300ms i will halt and rollback. please ping here if you see anomalies

lee: I'll tail auth logs and post anomalies, will also check for token refresh bursts around the canary window

oliver: LGTM on the CR, will approve after canary is stable. leaning to adding a short TTL warm-up in the rollout script to reduce cold-kv blips

maria: perfect. small test you can run locally to hit the header check:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" "https://staging.apigw.redwood/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .headers."X-Rate-Limit-Policy"
```

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll post a short follow-up once canary completes and link metrics

jamal: will review the e2e tonight, thanks
